title: Equal Teams by Strength
statement:
There are `n` players, and player `i` has strength `a_i`. Split all players into exactly `k` non-empty teams so that every team has the same total strength. Every player joins exactly one team.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains the `n` strengths.

## Output
Print `YES` if such a split exists, otherwise print `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 15`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^4`
